commands.name: Polite decline
commands.prompt: Rewrite the selected text as a polite, warm refusal. Keep the same decision and the same facts, add a brief thanks, and keep it short. Return only the rewritten text.

description.en: Turns a blunt refusal into a courteous one.
description.vi: Biến lời từ chối thẳng thành lời từ chối lịch sự.
